# IsoFrac Analyzer

Input: DIANN report.tsv tables and a fasta database (UniProt, other naming formats might be incompatible with the current code)

# Disclaimer

## Research Use Only

This software is provided as a research tool to facilitate the analysis of label-free DIA (Data-Independent Acquisition) proteomics data generated using DIA-NN. It is intended as a starting point (primer) for developing customized analysis workflows and is not designed as a universal or validated solution for all experimental designs.

This implementation deviates from the analysis workflow originally submitted and described in the associated manuscript. It incorporates modifications, refinements, and additional functionality that have been introduced during continued development. Consequently, results generated with this version may not be identical to those reported in the publication.

Users are responsible for verifying that the implemented methods, parameters, and assumptions are appropriate for their specific experimental setup, biological question, and data quality. ## Experimental Design and Fractions:

```{r}
assign_samples_to_experiments <- function(sample_names) {
  require(tcltk)
  require(data.table)
  
  tt <- tktoplevel()
  tkwm.title(tt, "Sample to Experiment Assignment")
  result_assign_samples_to_experiments <- data.table(Sample = sample_names, Experiment = NA_character_)
  
  main_frame <- tkframe(tt)
  tkgrid(main_frame)
  
  # Top Left: Mode selection
  frame_mode <- tkframe(main_frame)
  tkgrid(frame_mode, row = 0, column = 0, sticky = "nw")
  
  mode <- tclVar("manual")
  tkpack(tklabel(frame_mode, text = "Choose Assignment Mode"), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkradiobutton(frame_mode, text = "Manual", value = "manual", variable = mode), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkradiobutton(frame_mode, text = "Dropdown (Predefined Experiments)", value = "dropdown", variable = mode), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkradiobutton(frame_mode, text = "Regex", value = "regex", variable = mode), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkradiobutton(frame_mode, text = "strsplit", value = "split", variable = mode), anchor = "w")
  
  # Top Right: Assignment options
  frame_options <- tkframe(main_frame)
  tkgrid(frame_options, row = 0, column = 1, sticky = "new")
  
  experiment_list_var <- tclVar("")
  regex_var <- tclVar("")
  split_var <- tclVar("_")
  slot_var <- tclVar("2")
  
  tkpack(tklabel(frame_options, text = "Experiments (comma separated):"), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkentry(frame_options, textvariable = experiment_list_var, width = 40), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tklabel(frame_options, text = "Regex pattern (with capture group):"), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkentry(frame_options, textvariable = regex_var, width = 40), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tklabel(frame_options, text = "Split by (e.g. _):"), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkentry(frame_options, textvariable = split_var, width = 10), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tklabel(frame_options, text = "Slot(s) (e.g. 1,3):"), anchor = "w")
  tkpack(tkentry(frame_options, textvariable = slot_var, width = 10), anchor = "w")
  
  apply_mode <- function() {
    mode_sel <- tclvalue(mode)
    if (mode_sel == "manual") {
      for (i in seq_along(list_vars)) {
        result_assign_samples_to_experiments$Experiment[i] <- tclvalue(list_vars[[i]])
      }
    } else if (mode_sel == "dropdown") {
      exps <- unlist(strsplit(tclvalue(experiment_list_var), ",\\s*"))
      for (i in seq_along(sample_names)) {
        exp <- tk_select.list(exps, title = paste("Assign experiment for:", sample_names[i]))
        result_assign_samples_to_experiments$Experiment[i] <- exp
      }
    } else if (mode_sel == "regex") {
      pattern <- tclvalue(regex_var)
      for (i in seq_along(sample_names)) {
        match <- regmatches(sample_names[i], regexec(pattern, sample_names[i]))
        result_assign_samples_to_experiments$Experiment[i] <- if (length(match[[1]]) > 1) match[[1]][2] else NA_character_
      }
    } else if (mode_sel == "split") {
      split_char <- tclvalue(split_var)
      slots <- as.integer(unlist(strsplit(tclvalue(slot_var), ",")))
      for (i in seq_along(sample_names)) {
        parts <- unlist(strsplit(sample_names[i], split_char))
        selected <- parts[slots[slots <= length(parts)]]
        result_assign_samples_to_experiments$Experiment[i] <- paste(selected, collapse = "_")
      }
    }
    for (i in seq_along(sample_names)) {
      tclvalue(list_vars[[i]]) <- result_assign_samples_to_experiments$Experiment[i]
    }
  }
  
  apply_btn <- tkbutton(frame_options, text = "Apply Mode", command = apply_mode)
  tkpack(apply_btn, anchor = "w", pady = 10)
  
  # Bottom: Scrollable sample list
  canvas <- tkcanvas(main_frame, width = 600, height = 300)
  scroll <- tkscrollbar(main_frame, orient = "vertical", command = function(...) tkyview(canvas, ...))
  tkconfigure(canvas, yscrollcommand = function(...) tkset(scroll, ...))
  tkgrid(canvas, scroll, row = 1, column = 0, columnspan = 1, sticky = "nsew")
  tkgrid(scroll, row = 1, column = 1, sticky = "ns")
  
  sample_frame <- tkframe(canvas)
  tkcreate(canvas, "window", 0, 0, anchor = "nw", window = sample_frame)
  tkbind(sample_frame, "<Configure>", function() {
    tcl("update")
    bbox <- tkbbox(canvas, "all")
    tkconfigure(canvas, scrollregion = bbox)
  })
  
  tkgrid(tklabel(sample_frame, text = "Sample Assignments"), columnspan = 2)
  list_vars <- list()
  assign_widgets <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(sample_names)) {
    tkgrid(tklabel(sample_frame, text = sample_names[i]), row = i, column = 0, sticky = "w")
    var <- tclVar("")
    entry <- tkentry(sample_frame, textvariable = var, width = 50)
    list_vars[[i]] <- var
    assign_widgets[[i]] <- entry
    tkgrid(entry, row = i, column = 1, sticky = "we")
  }
  
  # Done Button Bottom Right
  ok_btn <- tkbutton(tt, text = "Done", command = function() {
    for (i in seq_along(list_vars)) {
      result_assign_samples_to_experiments$Experiment[i] <<- tclvalue(list_vars[[i]])
    }
    tkdestroy(tt)
  })
  tkgrid(ok_btn, row = 2, column = 1, sticky = "e", pady = 10)
  
  tkwait.window(tt)
  return(result_assign_samples_to_experiments)
}
ED <- assign_samples_to_experiments(unique(da$Run))
# Assigning Experiment
da$Experiment <- ED[match(da$Run,ED$Sample)]$Experiment
# Removing Empty Entries
da <- da[da$Experiment!=""]

# Assigning Fractions:
Fr <- assign_samples_to_experiments(unique(da$Run))
da$Fraction <- Fr[match(da$Run,Fr$Sample)]$Experiment
da <- da[Lib.Q.Value< 0.01]# apply filters here
da$CellType <- "Unknown" # PlaceHolder
```

## Compiling Table

```{r ,echo=FALSE}
# Defining Experiment paths, multiple rns could be put together

IF_Read_Dia <- function(temp,QuantificationColumn="Ms1.Area"){
  library(ggplot2)
  Gene <- temp[,length(unique(Fraction)),Genes]

  # temp$Fraction <- as.numeric(temp$Fraction)
  
  tempdcast <- dcast(temp,Protein.Group+Genes+Modified.Sequence+Precursor.Charge~Fraction,value.var = QuantificationColumn,fun.aggregate=max)
  Posinfo <- which(names(tempdcast)=="Precursor.Charge")
  infotable <- as.data.frame(tempdcast)[,1:Posinfo]
  Traces <- as.data.frame(tempdcast)[,(Posinfo+1):dim(tempdcast)[2]]
  
  BadEntries <- apply(Traces,1,function(x){sum(is.infinite(unlist(x)))})
  
  list(Original=temp,InfoTable=infotable,traces=Traces,traces_scaled = t(scale(t(Traces))),BadCount = BadEntries)
}

da_split <- split(da,da$Experiment)
CompiledTable_list <- lapply(da_split,IF_Read_Dia)
```

## Functions

```{r}
PeakTesting <- function(tempsel,temp,Candidates,samplingrounds = 50,seed=T,cutoff=0.1){
  set.seed(1234)
  tempsel <<- tempsel
  temp <<- temp
  
  # Generating Comparison Matrix for statistical Testing
  distributionCheck <- function(x){
    sdval <- 10^c(x$MW_lm,x$MW_fr_gel_hi,x$MW_lm_gel_lo)
    rnorm(10,mean=10^x$MW_lm,sd = sd(sdval))
  }
  
  hu <- lapply(1:samplingrounds,function(x){
    ComparisonMatrix <- lapply(1:dim(temp)[1],function(i){
      temp <- temp[i, ]
      vecfun <- distributionCheck(temp)
      list(Data=vecfun,Sample=i,MW=10^as.numeric(temp$MW_lm[i]))
    })
    ComparisonMatrix <- rbindlist(ComparisonMatrix)
    ComparisonMatrix$MW <- round(10^temp$MW_lm[ComparisonMatrix$Sample])
    options(warn=-1)
    pvalues <- sapply(Candidates$CandidateID,function(it){
      a <- ComparisonMatrix[Sample==tempsel$CandidateID]
      b <- ComparisonMatrix[Sample==it]
      pval <- as.double(NA)
      try(pval <- wilcox.test(a$Data,b$Data)$p.value)
      
      
    })
    
    options(warn=1)
    
    list(pvalues=pvalues,ID=Candidates$CandidateID,Sampling=x)
  })
  ComparisonMatrix <- rbindlist(hu)
  
  SimilarityIndex <- ComparisonMatrix[,any(pvalues>cutoff),ID]
  temp$similarities <- SimilarityIndex$V1[match(temp$CandidateID,SimilarityIndex$ID)]
  
  list(ComparisonMatrix=ComparisonMatrix,SimilarityIndex=SimilarityIndex,temp=temp)
}

MW_Trace <- function(input,UNIPROTKB=NULL,FractionCutoff=c(1,10000),bs_rounds=50){
  # ggplot(,aes(Fraction,log10(MW)))+geom_bin2d()+facet_grid("CellType")+ggtitle("PG first entry MW")+geom_smooth()+
  # annotate("segment",x=1,xend=12,y = upperlimit,yend = upperlimit,color="orange")+annotate("text",x=4,xend=10,y = upperlimit,yend = upperlimit,label="Signal",color="orange",vjust=1)+
  # annotate("segment",x=1,xend=1,y = upperlimit,yend = lowerlimit,color="orange")+annotate("text",x=0,xend=0,y = av,yend = av,label=paste("MW signal",paste(round(10^c(lowerlimit,upperlimit)/1000),collapse=" to "),"kd"),color="orange",vjust=0,angle=90)
  library(pracma)
  input <- ori
  # 
  input$Fraction <- factor(input$Fraction,1:max(input$Fraction,na.rm=T))
  input[,AnySignal :={any(Ms1.Area>0)},CellType]
  inputMini <- input[AnySignal==T]
  mapData  <- dcast(inputMini,Stripped.Sequence+Protein.Group~Fraction,fun.aggregate = sum,value.var = "Ms1.Area",fill = 0,drop = c(TRUE,FALSE))
  
  peptides <- mapData$Stripped.Sequence
  proteins <- mapData$Protein.Group
  
  mapData$Stripped.Sequence <- NULL
  mapData$Protein.Group <- NULL
  
  # Mapping mw of proteins
  splitfun <- strsplit(proteins,";")
  ACC_stripped <- sapply(splitfun,function(x){x[1]})
  # ACC_stripped <- gsub("-.$","",sapply(strsplit(input$dt_gn$UniAccesspepion,";"),"[[",1))
  ACC_stripped <- gsub("-..$","",ACC_stripped)
  acc <- unique(ACC_stripped)
  
  if(length(UNIPROTKB)==0){
    warning("no DB provided")
    return(NULL)
  }
  UniAccM <- UNIPROTKB[match(ACC_stripped,IDclean)]
  

  
  #########
  
  mapData$MW <- UniAccM$MW
  mapData$Sequence <- peptides

  Sel <- sapply(strsplit(proteins,";"),function(x){
    length(unique(gsub("_.*.","",x)))
  })
  SelSum <- table(Sel)
  SelSumSel <- SelSum[SelSum>500]# minimize number of multiple Mapping Proteins
  
  sel <- Sel==names(SelSumSel[names(SelSumSel)==min(names(SelSumSel))])#input$InputTable$`Unique (Proteins)`=="yes"
  
  options(warn=-1)
  MeltDataSpecific <- mapData[sel,{
    # cat("\r",.GRP)
    temp <- .SD
    temp <- unlist(temp)#[1:24]
    sel <- temp==max(temp,na.rm = T)
    sel[is.na(sel)]<- F
    sel[is.infinite(sel)]<- F
    
    # if(any(is.))
    which(sel)
    
    
  },.(Sequence)]
  options(warn=1)
  
  
  MeltDataSpecific$MW_ENSP <- mapData[match(MeltDataSpecific$Sequence,Sequence),]$MW
  
  MeltDataSpecific <- MeltDataSpecific[V1>=FractionCutoff[1]&V1<=FractionCutoff[2]]

  smoothScatter(MeltDataSpecific$V1,log10(as.numeric(MeltDataSpecific$MW_ENSP)),axes=T,ylab="mw Da",xlab="fraction",main=input$xname,ylim=c(3,6))
  mtext("All")
  options(warn=-1)
  LAFU <- lapply(1:bs_rounds,function(i){
    # cat("\r",i)
    MW_density <- MeltDataSpecific[,{
      MW_temp <- .SD
      li <- NULL
      try({
        li <- temp_d<- density(log2(sample(as.numeric(MW_temp$MW_ENSP),replace = T)),bw=0.1,na.rm = T)
        # plot(temp_d)
        
        fi_p <- findpeaks(temp_d$y)
        mw_sel <- fi_p[fi_p[,1]==max(fi_p[,1]),]
        wi <- 0.2
        qs <- quantile(temp_d$x[temp_d$x>=(temp_d$x[mw_sel[2]]-wi)&temp_d$x<=(temp_d$x[mw_sel[2]]+wi)],probs = c(0.1,0.9))
        # plot(temp_d)
        # abline(v=temp_d$x[mw_sel[2]])
        li <- list(m=2^temp_d$x[mw_sel[2]],q1=2^qs[1],q2=2^qs[2])
      })
      li
      
    },.(fraction=V1)]
    
    
    lmMod <- lm(log10(MW_density$m)~MW_density$fraction)

    sel <- abs(lmMod$residuals)>0.5
    
    abline(coefficients(lmMod),col = 2,lwd = "dotted")
    lo2 <- loess(log10(MW_density$m)[!sel]~MW_density$fraction[!sel],span = 0.5,surface = "direct" )
    lo2_lo <- loess(log10(MW_density$q1)[!sel]~MW_density$fraction[!sel],span = 0.5,surface = "direct" )
    lo2_hi <- loess(log10(MW_density$q2)[!sel]~MW_density$fraction[!sel],span = 0.5,surface = "direct" )
    
    points(lo2$x[order(lo2$x)],lo2$fitted[order(lo2$x)],type="l",col = "red",alpha=0.5,lwd=3)
    points(lo2_lo$x[order(lo2_lo$x)],lo2_lo$fitted[order(lo2_lo$x)],type="l",col = "lightgreen",alpha=0.5,lwd = "dotted")
    points(lo2_hi$x[order(lo2_hi$x)],lo2_hi$fitted[order(lo2_hi$x)],type="l",col = "lightgreen",alpha=0.5,lwd = "dotted")
    
    qs <- quantile(lo2$fitted[order(lo2$x)],na.rm = T)
    axis(4,at=qs,labels = paste(round((10^qs)/1000),"kD"),4,las=2,cex=0.5)
    abline(h=qs,lty=c(3,2,1,2,3)) 
    
    list(md=lo2,md_lo=lo2_lo,md_hi=lo2_hi,MW_density=MW_density,lmMod=lmMod$residuals)
  })
  
  
  rb <- rbindlist(lapply(LAFU,function(x){
    x <- x
    
    x$MW_density$lmMod <- x$lmMod[match(x$MW_density$fraction,names(x$lmMod))]
    x$MW_density
  }))
  rb <- rb[,{
    hum <- .SD[abs(lmMod)<0.5]
    if(dim(hum)[1]==0){
      print(.BY$fraction)
      hum <- .SD[abs(lmMod)<1]
      hum <<- .SD
    }
    if(all(is.na(lmMod))){
      hum <- .SD
    }
    hum
    
  },fraction]
  
  table(rb$fraction)
  
  rb <- rb[order(rb$fraction)]
  
  pdf("Bootstrap_SmoothScatter_SEC.pdf")
  par(mai=c(1,1,1,1))
  smoothScatter(MeltDataSpecific$V1,log10(as.numeric(MeltDataSpecific$MW_ENSP)),axes=T,ylab="mw Da",xlab="fraction",main=paste(gsub("/.*.","",input$xname),"Step 2 Loess on average Bootstrapping points",sep = "\n"))
  points(rb$fraction,log10(rb$m),pch=20,col="darkgrey")
  md <- loess(log10(rb$m)~rb$fraction,surface = "direct" ,span=0.5) 
  points(md$x,md$fitted,type="l",col = 2,lwd=2)  
  md_1 <- loess(log10(rb$q1)~rb$fraction,surface = "direct" ,span=0.5) 
  points(md_1$x,md_1$fitted,type="l",col = 3)  
  md_2 <- loess(log10(rb$q2)~rb$fraction,surface = "direct" ,span=0.5) 
  points(md_2$x,md_2$fitted,type="l",col = 3) 
  
  qs <- quantile(md$fitted[order(md$x)],na.rm = T)
  axis(4,at=qs,labels = paste(round((10^qs)/1000),"kD"),4,las=2,cex=0.5)
  abline(h=qs,lty=c(3,2,1,2,3)) 
  dev.off()
  system("open Bootstrap_SmoothScatter_SEC.pdf")
  MeltDataSpecific <<- 
  gp <- ggplot(data = MeltDataSpecific, aes(V1, log10(as.numeric(MW_ENSP)))) +   stat_density2d(aes(fill = ..density..^0.5), geom = "tile", contour = FALSE, n = 300) +   scale_fill_continuous(low = "white", high = "darkblue")+theme(legend.position = "none")+xlab("Fractions")+ylab("log10 Protein MW")+
    annotate("line",md$x,md$fitted,color="red")+annotate("line",md_1$x,md_1$fitted,color="skyblue",lty="dotted")+annotate("line",md_2$x,md_2$fitted,color="skyblue",lty="dotted")+geom_hline(yintercept = qs,lty=c("dotted","dashed","solid","dashed","dotted"))+
    annotate("text",x=max(md$x),y=qs,label=paste(round(10^(qs)/1000),"kD"),vjust=-1)
  
  
  list(md=md,hi=md_1,lo=md_2,data=MeltDataSpecific,gg=gp)
  
  
}

Isofrac_PeakFinder <- function(it,ens_vector=NULL,randomized= F,inputSmall=inputSmall,pathAdd="./",clusterType="cl_2",BSrounds=10){
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pracma)
  library(parallel)
  it <<- it 
  randomized <<- randomized
  pathAdd <<- pathAdd
  cat("\r PeakFinder",it)
  # ens <- "ENSG00000167193"# crk
  ens <- ens_vector[it]
  if(!randomized){
    pathname <- paste(pathAdd,"PeakFinder",sep = "/")
    try({
      dir.create(pathname,showWarnings = F)
      nam <- paste("PeakFinder_it",it,sep = "")
      write(c(it,ens),paste(pathname,nam,sep = "/"))
      
    })
  }else{
    try({
      pathname <- paste(pathAdd,"PeakFinder",sep = "/")
      
      dir.create(pathname,showWarnings = F)
      nam <- paste("PeakFinder_it",it,sep = "")
      write(c(it,ens),paste(pathname,nam,sep = "/"))
      
    })
  }
  
  
  # if(any(grepl(";",ens))){
  #   return(NULL)
  # }
  PeaksEnsg <- list(Problem="Yes")
  try({
    # it <<- it
    
    # ens = "ENSG00000120802"
    if(randomized){
      sel <- inputSmall$dt_gn$ens==ens
      if(all(!sel)){return(NULL)}
      
      hdbscanTable <- inputSmall$hdbscanTables_random[EnsG==ens]
      dt <- inputSmall$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[hdbscanTable$id,]
      sel2 <- rep(T,dim(dt)[1])
      
      # sel2 <- hdbscanTable$FDR_RF< 0.05
      # sel2[is.na(sel2)] <- F
      
    }else{
      sel <- inputSmall$dt_gn$ens==ens
      sel[is.na(sel)] <- F
      if(all(!sel)){return(NULL)}
      dt <- inputSmall$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[sel,]
      hdbscanTable <- inputSmall$hdbscanTables[EnsG==ens,]
      
      hdbscanTable <- hdbscanTable[match(inputSmall$InputTable$Sequence[sel],hdbscanTable$Seq)]# what is the purpose of this line?
      # dt <- dt[match(inputSmall$InputTable$Sequence[sel],hdbscanTable$Seq)]# what is the purpose of this line?
      
      if(length(hdbscanTable$FDR_RF)==0){
        hdbscanTable$FDR_RF <- 0
      }
      hdbscanTable$FDR_RF[is.na(hdbscanTable$FDR_RF)]<-1
      
      sel2 <- hdbscanTable$FDR_RF<10 # switched off
      sel2[is.na(sel2)] <- F 
    }
    
    # plot(Gpplot_LineTraces(dt[sel2,],applyhdbclust = F))
    if(all(!sel2)){return(NULL)}
    
    library(pracma)
    
    hdbscanTable2 <- hdbscanTable#[sel2,]# FDR Control, but not used anymore
    dt2 <- dt#[sel2,]
    if(clusterType=="cl_2"){
      hdbscanTable2$cl_2[is.na(hdbscanTable2$cl_2)] <- -1
      cls <- setdiff(unique(hdbscanTable2$cl_2),c(0,-1))
      hdbscanTable2$UsedClusters <- hdbscanTable2$cl_2
      
    }else{
      hdbscanTable2$cl_3[is.na(hdbscanTable2$cl_3)] <- -1
      cls <- setdiff(unique(hdbscanTable2$cl_3),c(0,-1))
      hdbscanTable2$UsedClusters <- hdbscanTable2$cl_3
      
    }
    
    if(length(cls)==0){
      return(1)
    }
    # clusterExport(cl,c("dt2","hdbscanTable2"))
    PeaksEnsglist <- lapply(sort(cls),function(clsi){
      cat("\r",clsi)
      clsi <<- clsi
      temp <- dt2[hdbscanTable2$UsedClusters==clsi,]
      
      
      TempMean2 <- sapply(1:20,function(x){
        TempMean <- apply(temp[sample(1:dim(temp)[1],replace = T),],2,median,na.rm = T)
        TempMean
      })
      TempMean <- t(TempMean2)
      TempMeanSmooth <- apply(TempMean,2,median,na.rm = T)
      
      TempMeanSd <- apply(TempMean2,2,function(x){sd(x,na.rm=T)})
      
      # TempMean <- apply(temp,2,median,na.rm = T)
      # TempMeanSmooth <- savgol(TempMean,11,forder= 4,dorder=0)
      
      fp <- data.table(findpeaks(TempMeanSmooth,nups = 1,ndowns = 1,threshold = 0.1))
      if(dim(fp)[1]==0){
        return(NULL)
      }
      # fp2 <- data.table(findpeaks(TempMean,nups = 1,ndowns = 1))
      fp$smooth <- F
      # fp2$smooth <- F
      
      colnames(fp) <- c("Height","Peak","Start","End","Smooth")
      fp[,c("StartDiff","EndDiff","PeakSD"):={
        gr <- .BY
        f1 <- TempMeanSmooth[(.BY$Peak-1):.BY$Start]
        f2 <- TempMeanSmooth[(.BY$Peak+1):.BY$End]
        f1.1 <<- .BY$Height-mean(f1,na.rm = T)
        f2.2 <<- .BY$Height-mean(f2,na.rm = T)
        
        list(f1.1,f2.2,mean(TempMeanSd[.BY$Start:.BY$End],na.rm=T))
        
      },.(Height,Peak,Start,End,Smooth)]
      qcutof <-quantile(unlist(temp),c(0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2),na.rm = T)
      fp$Q0p5CutOff <- qcutof[1]
      fp$Q1CutOff <- qcutof[2]
      fp$Q1p5CutOff <- qcutof[3]
      fp$Q2CutOff <- qcutof[4]
      
      fp$Median <- median(unlist(temp),na.rm = T)
      
      
      colorder <- colnames(fp)
      # fp <- fp[,{
      #   temp <- .SD
      #   temp$mpw <- NULL
      #   data.frame(unique(temp),mpw =max(mpw,na.rm = T))
      #   
      # },Peak]
      setcolorder(fp,colorder)
      if(length(fp)==0){return(NULL)}
      col <- rainbow(dim(fp)[1],alpha = 0.5)
      # sapply(1:dim(fp)[1],function(it){
      #   x <- fp[it,]
      #   polygon(c(x[3],x[4],x[4],x[3]),c(rep(-2,2),rep(2,2)),col = col[it],border = NA)
      #   NULL
      # })
      if(length(fp)>0){
        # plot(TempMeanSmooth,type ="l")
        # apply(temp,1,function(x){
        #   points(x,type="l")
        # })
        
        col <- rainbow(dim(fp)[1],alpha = 0.2,v=0.8)
        plotstuffSet <- F
        if(plotstuffSet){
          plot(TempMeanSmooth,type ="l")
          apply(temp,1,function(x){
            points(x,type="l")
          })
        }
        
        
        Peaks <- sapply(1:dim(fp)[1],function(it,plotstuff=plotstuffSet){
          it <<- it
          PositionTable <- rep(NA,9)
          ({
            x <- unlist(fp[it,])
            if(plotstuff){
              polygon(c(x[3],x[4],x[4],x[3]),c(rep(-2,2),rep(2,2)),col = col[it],border = NA)
              abline(v=x[2],lty = "dotted",col=purecol<- gsub("..$","",col[it]),lwd = 2)
            }
            
            
            # if(diff(c(x[2:3]))>1){
            #   correct <- 1
            # }else{
            #   correct <- 0
            # }
            
            
            # LM from the left
            
            lm_1 <- lm_checker(x[3],x[2],temp)
            lm_2 <- lm_checker(x[2],x[4],temp,cutatstart = F)
            
            CoefReal <- lmIntx(lm_1$md,lm_2$md)
            # cl2 <- makeCluster(5)
            
            # clusterExport(cl2,c("temp","lm_checker","x","rbindlist","lmIntx"))
            # print("BOOTSTRAP")
            lm_bs <- sapply(1:BSrounds,function(it){
              # cat("\r",it)
              lm_1 <- lm_checker(x[3],x[2],temp,bootstrap = T)
              lm_2 <- lm_checker(x[2],x[4],temp,bootstrap = T,cutatstart = F)
              if(is.na(lm_1$md$coefficients[2])|is.na(lm_2$md$coefficients[2])){
                CoefReal <- data.frame(x=NA,y=NA)
              }else{ 
                CoefReal <- lmIntx(lm_1$md,lm_2$md)
              }
              
              unlist(CoefReal)
            })
            quantile_80 <- apply(lm_bs,1,quantile,probs=c(0.1,0.9),na.rm = T)
            sd_80 <- apply(lm_bs,1,function(x){sd(x,na.rm=T)})
            
            PositionTable <- cbind(CoefReal,t(as.matrix(as.vector(quantile_80))),lm_1$n,t(as.matrix(as.vector(sd_80))))
            names(PositionTable) <- c("Fraction_lm","Height_lm","Fraction_BS_lo","Fraction_BS_hi","Height_BS_lo","Height_BS_hi","n","Fraction_sd_80","Height_sd_80")
            PositionTable$Fraction_width <- diff(c(PositionTable$Fraction_BS_lo,PositionTable$Fraction_BS_hi))
            PositionTable$Height_width <- diff(c(PositionTable$Height_BS_lo,PositionTable$Height_BS_hi))
            
            
          })
          
          # c(x,xout,yout,xout_all,yout_all,xsd=NA,ysd=NA,xsd_all=NA,ysd_all=NA,coefs)
          
          
          cbind(t(as.matrix(x)),PositionTable)
          
        })
        
        print("DONE")
        Peaks <- t(Peaks)
        Peaks <- data.frame(Peaks)
        
      }else{return(NULL)}
      Peaks$cluster2 <- clsi
      Peaks
    })
    print("Combining")
    PeaksEnsglist2 <<- PeaksEnsglist
    print(lengths(PeaksEnsglist))
    PeaksEnsg <- rbindlist(PeaksEnsglist)
    PeaksEnsg$ENS <- ens
  })
  PeaksEnsg
}
lmIntx <- function(fit1, fit2, rnd=2) {
  
  b1<- fit1$coefficient[1]  #y-int for fit1
  m1<- fit1$coefficient[2]  #slope for fit1
  b2<- fit2$coefficient[1]  #y-int for fit2
  m2<- fit2$coefficient[2]  #slope for fit2
  df <- data.frame(x=NA, y=NA)
  
  if(m1==m2 & b1==b2) {print("Lines are identical")
  } else if(m1==m2 & b1 != b2) {print("Lines are parallel")
  } else {
    x <- (b2-b1)/(m1-m2)      #solved general equation for x
    y <- m1*x + b1            #plug in the result
    df <- data.frame(x=round(x, rnd), y=round(y, rnd))
  }
  df
}
lm_checker <- function(start,end,df,bootstrap=F,rangeCutoff = 3,cutatstart=T,ggplotstuff=F){
 
  x1 <- start:end
  if(cutatstart){
    if(diff(range(x1))>rangeCutoff){
      x1 <- (start+rangeCutoff-1):end
    }
  }else{
    if(diff(range(x1))>rangeCutoff){
      x1 <- (start):(end-rangeCutoff+1)
    }
  }
  
  
  # x1 <- start:end
  x1_all <- lapply(x1,function(itx){
    data.frame(itx,data.frame(df)[,itx])
  })
  x_all <- lapply(1:dim(df)[2],function(itx){
    data.frame(itx,data.frame(df)[,itx])
  })
  x_all <- rbindlist(x_all)
  x1_all <- rbindlist(x1_all)
  if(bootstrap){
    s <- sample(1:dim(x1_all)[1],replace = T)
    lm_md <- lm(as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[s,2]))~as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[s,1])))
  }else{
    lm_md <- lm(as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[,2]))~as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[,1])))
  }
  names(x_all) <- c("V1","V2")
  names(x1_all) <- c("V1","V2")
  
  # plotting
  g <- NA
  try({
    coef <- coefficients(lm_md)
    g <- ggplot(x_all,aes(V1,V2))+geom_point()+geom_abline(slope=coef[2],intercept = coef[1])+geom_vline(xintercept = range(x1),lty= "dotted")
    if(ggplotstuff){
      print(g)
    }
  })
  # 
  
  list(md=lm_md,x1_all=x1_all,g=g,n=dim(x1_all)[1])
}

IsoFrac_Compiler.DIANN <- function(ori,# long list table from DIANN containing a column with the assigend Fractions
                                   threads=5,fillNA=-1,MD=NULL){
  if(all(names(ori)!="Fraction")){
    warning("Please add a Fraction column to the ori table")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if(any(is.na(ori$Fraction))){
    
    warning(paste("NAs detected in the Fraction column. Analysis might be compromised. NAs:",sum(is.na(ori$Fraction))))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  
  
  cat("\r","addind Measures\n")
  ori[,GeneSummed:=sum(Ms1.Area,na.rm=T),Genes]
  ori[,Count:=length(Ms1.Area),Genes]
  
  
  if(length(MD)==0){
    MD <- MW_Trace(ori,UNIPROTKB)$md
  }
  
  print("Step2 Clustering and Peaks Identification")
  
  library(parallel)
  cat("\r","Initiating Cluster\n")
  cl <- makeCluster(threads)
  cat("\r","Preparing Cluster\n")
  clusterExport(cl,"")
  
  Genes <- unique(ori$Genes)
  Genes <- Genes[Genes!=""]
  Genes <- Genes[!is.na(Genes)]
  g="cRAP−AHSG"
  parLapply(Genes,IsoFrac_PeakfinderWrapper)
  
  
  
  
  
  
}

IsoFrac_PeakfinderWrapper <- function(ori,g,quantification="Precursor.Normalised",MD=NULL){
  library(dbscan)
  
  o <- ori[g==Genes]
  # Dbscan Clsutering
  # First Clustering
  o$Fraction <- factor(o$Fraction,min(o$Fraction,na.rm=T):max(o$Fraction,na.rm=T))
  om <- dcast(o,Stripped.Sequence~Fraction,value.var =quantification,fun.aggregate = sum,fill = NA,drop = c(FALSE,TRUE) )
  # om <- scale(t(om))
  omse <- om$Stripped.Sequence
  om$Stripped.Sequence <- NULL
  om$`NA` <- NULL
  om<- data.table(t(scale(t(om))))
  om[is.na(om)] <- rnorm(sum(is.na(om)),-0.5,0.01)
  # Second Lelel Clustering
  if(dim(om)[1]>200){
    
    o$cl <- "grey22"
  }else{
    o$cl <- "grey22"
    try({ hdbresult <- hdbscan(apply(om,2,function(x){x[is.na(x)] <- 0;as.numeric(x)} ),2)})
    try({ hdbresult3 <- hdbscan(apply(om,2,function(x){x[is.na(x)] <- 0;as.numeric(x)} ),3)})
    
    try({o$cl <- hdbresult$cluster[match(o$Modified.Sequence,omse)]})
  }
  cat("\r","Peak Finding \n")
  
  inputSmall <- list()
  
  inputSmall$hdbscanTables_random <- NULL
  inputSmall$hdbscanTables <-  data.table(EnsG="ENSGtemp",cl_2 = hdbresult$cluster,cl_3=hdbresult3$cluster,cl_2_nf   =hdbresult$cluster,Seq=omse)
  inputSmall$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore <- om
  inputSmall$dt_gn <- data.table(hgnc_symbol="temp",gn="temp",ens="ENSGtemp",UniAccession="temp",seq=omse,Use=T,ens_original="TEMP",ens_Count=1)
  
  inputSmall$InputTable <- data.frame(Sequence=omse)
  ens_vector <- unique(inputSmall$dt_gn $ens)
  huha <- Isofrac_PeakFinder(1,inputSmall=inputSmall,pathAdd = "./",randomized = F,ens_vector=ens_vector,BSrounds = 10)
  huha$Peak_MW <- predict(MD$md,unlist(huha$Peak)+min((as.numeric(names(om))))-1)
  huha$End_MW <- predict(MD$md,unlist(huha$Start)+min((as.numeric(names(om))))-1)
  huha$Start_MW <- predict(MD$md,unlist(huha$End)+min((as.numeric(names(om))))-1)
  huha$MW_lm <- predict(MD$md,unlist(huha$Fraction_lm)+min((as.numeric(names(om))))-1)
  huha$MW_fr_gel_hi <- predict(MD$lo,unlist(huha$Fraction_lm)+min((as.numeric(names(om))))-1)
  huha$MW_lm_gel_lo <- predict(MD$hi,unlist(huha$Fraction_lm)+min((as.numeric(names(om))))-1)
  
  
  
  o$cl[is.na(o$cl)] <- "grey22"
  
  om_melt_prepar <- om
  om_melt_prepar$sequence <- omse
  om_melt_prepar$cl <- hdbresult$cluster
  om_melt <- melt(om_melt_prepar,measure.vars =names(om) )
  om_melt$MW <- predict(MD$md,om_melt$variable)
  
  
  print("Complexity Reduction:")
  huha$PeakfinderSet <- "cl_2" # option to run multiple peakfinders with different Clustering Events
  ipr_compressed <- Compression_Function_ForDT(huha)
  ipr_PeakIdentity <- ipr_compressed[,{
    # cat("\r",.BY$ENS)
    temp <- .SD
    temp$id <- 1:dim(temp)[1]
    
    temp$Compressed_MW_Variants <- temp$MW_lm
    temp
    
  },.(ENS,PeakfinderSet)]
  
  
 
  
  
  list(Traces=om_melt,Peaks=huha,Peaks_Compressed=ipr_PeakIdentity)
  
  
}

Compression_Function_ForDT <- function(x,zscoreCutoff=1,FractionCutoff=10,PeakScore_DL_Cutoff =0.1,safety_width=2500){
  
  library(data.table)
  {
    # cat("\r",.GRP)
    temp <- as.data.table(x)
    if(all(temp$Height<=max(zscoreCutoff))){
      temp$ZscoreClass <- min(zscoreCutoff)
    }else{
      temp$ZscoreClass <- max(zscoreCutoff)
      
    }
    
    temp <- temp[order(unlist(Height),decreasing = T)]
    temp$Selection <- 1
    temp$id <- 0
    id<- 1
    moveon <- T
    temp$CandidateID <- 1:dim(temp)[1]
    temp$hierarchie <- 0
    Candidates <- temp
    it <- 0
    while(any(as.logical(temp$Selection))&moveon){
      it <- it+1
      
      # Current Selection
      tempsel <- temp[Selection==1&!is.na(match(temp$CandidateID,Candidates$CandidateID))][1,]
      
      # Checking same fraction
      if(any(sel <-( 10^tempsel$Start_MW-safety_width)<=(10^Candidates$Peak_MW)&(10^tempsel$End_MW+safety_width)>=(10^Candidates$Peak_MW))
         |any(sel <-( 10^Candidates$Start_MW-safety_width)<=(10^tempsel$Peak_MW)&(10^Candidates$End_MW+safety_width)>=(10^tempsel$Peak_MW))
      ){
        
        PeakTestingResults <- PeakTesting(tempsel,temp,Candidates)
        
        Selection <- PeakTestingResults$SimilarityIndex[V1==TRUE]$ID
        if(length(Selection)>0){
          sel[is.na(match(Candidates$CandidateID,Selection))] <- F
        }
        # Setting Selection to main Peak
        temp$hierarchie[temp$CandidateID==tempsel$CandidateID] <- 1
        # Defining ID of minor peaks
        temp[match(Candidates$CandidateID[sel],CandidateID)]$id <- tempsel$CandidateID
        temp[match(Candidates$CandidateID[sel],CandidateID)]$Selection <- 0
      
        Candidates <- Candidates[is.na(match(Candidates$CandidateID,temp$CandidateID[temp$Selection==0])),]
      }
      # Checking adjacent Fractions within Peak Boundaries
      
      
      
      if(dim(Candidates)[1]>0&it<=dim(Candidates)[1]){
        moveon <- T
      }else{
        moveon <- F
      }
      
    }
    temp$UsedClusters
    tempBackup <- temp
    temp <- tempBackup
    temp[,c("clusters","UsedClustersGroup","gels","heights","Peaks_collapse","n_Peaks"):={
      te <- .SD
      list(paste(te$cluster2,collapse=";"),
           paste(te$UsedClusters,collapse=";"),
           paste(te$gel,collapse=";"),
           paste(te$Height,collapse=";"),
           paste(te$Peak,collapse=";"),
           length(unique(te$cluster2)))
    },id]
    # print(dim(temp))
    (  temp[hierarchie==1,])
    
  }
}
### Enrichment 
hyper_equal_or_more <- function(x,m,n,k){
  dhyper(x,m,n,k) + phyper(x,m,n,k,lower.tail=F)
}
EnrichmentFunction <- function(Target,Candidate,ProteinPeptideMappings){
  # Target <<- Target
  # Candidate <<- Candidate
  UniProt <- ProteinPeptideMappings[ID==Target]
  Isofrac <- ProteinPeptideMappings[Compressed_MW_Variants==Candidate]
  
  
  Uniprot_Peptides <- (UniProt[ID==Target]$Peptide)
  Isofrac_Peptides            <-  (unique(Isofrac$Peptide))
  allBalls <- c(unique(ProteinPeptideMappings$Peptide),"noiseadd")
  
  PickedWhite <- unique(intersect(Isofrac_Peptides,Uniprot_Peptides))
  PickedIsofrac <- unique(intersect(Uniprot_Peptides,Isofrac_Peptides))
  
  AllWhite <- unique(Uniprot_Peptides)
  blackBalls <- unique(setdiff(allBalls,Uniprot_Peptides))
  
  
  p <- hyper_equal_or_more(x=length(PickedWhite),#whitballs picked from the urn
                           m=length(AllWhite),# number of white balls
                           n= length(blackBalls),# number of black balls
                           k=length(Isofrac_Peptides))# total number drawn from the urn)
  
  o <- list(p,
            length(PickedWhite),#whitballs picked from the urn
            length(AllWhite),# number of white balls
            length(blackBalls),# number of black balls
            length(PickedWhite)/length(Isofrac),# Overlap Uniprot / Number of Isofrac,
            length(PickedIsofrac)/length(AllWhite),# Overlap Isofrac / Number of Uniprot,
            
            length(allBalls)
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_traces <- function(input,lwd=NULL,removeZeroCl=F,AverageCluster=F,smooth=F){
  inputfinal <- input$Traces
  if(removeZeroCl){
      inputfinal <- input$Traces[cl!=0]

  }
  if(AverageCluster){
    inputfinal <<- inputfinal
    inputfinal <- inputfinal[,{list(value=median(value,na.rm=T),sequence=.BY$cl)},.(cl,variable,MW)]
      gg <- ggplot(inputfinal,aes(10^MW,value,group=sequence,color=as.character(cl)))+geom_line(lwd=lwd)+annotate("text",unlist(10^input$Peaks_Compressed$MW_lm),unlist(input$Peaks_Compressed$Height_lm),label=paste("==> ",round(10^input$Peaks_Compressed$MW_lm/1000),"kD <==",sep=""))
  }else{
    if(smooth){
            gg <- ggplot(inputfinal,aes(10^MW,value,group=cl,color=as.character(cl)))+geom_smooth(span=0.5)+annotate("text",unlist(10^input$Peaks_Compressed$MW_lm),unlist(input$Peaks_Compressed$Height_lm),label=paste("==> ",round(10^input$Peaks_Compressed$MW_lm/1000),"kD <==",sep=""))

    }else{
      gg <- ggplot(inputfinal,aes(10^MW,value,group=sequence,color=as.character(cl)))+geom_line(lwd=lwd)+annotate("text",unlist(10^input$Peaks_Compressed$MW_lm),unlist(input$Peaks_Compressed$Height_lm),label=paste("==> ",round(10^input$Peaks_Compressed$MW_lm/1000),"kD <==",sep=""))

    }
  }
   
gg+ggtitle(input$gene)+ylab("zscore")+xlab("MW")
}
```
